description: Connects a dietary supplement product reported by NHANES participants to an organism represented among its discrete ingredients. The edge records ingredient category and amount information.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time this relationship was last created or updated.

common_properties.name: quantity
common_properties.description: Ingredient amounts reported in NHANES Ingredient Information (DSII).
common_properties.notes: quantity, unit, operator are index-aligned (element i is the i-th contributing ingredient's amount/unit/operator). In the common single-ingredient case each list has length 1.

common_properties.name: unit
common_properties.description: Raw NHANES amount-unit codes; the modeling documentation provides no code-to-label table.
common_properties.notes: quantity, unit, operator are index-aligned (element i is the i-th contributing ingredient's amount/unit/operator). In the common single-ingredient case each list has length 1.

common_properties.name: operator
common_properties.notes: quantity, unit, operator are index-aligned (element i is the i-th contributing ingredient's amount/unit/operator). In the common single-ingredient case each list has length 1.

common_properties.name: category
common_properties.description: Ingredient category: Vitamin, Mineral, Botanical, Other, or Amino acid. When contributing ingredients have different categories, the value is Other.

source_contributions.scope: Dietary supplement products and discrete ingredients from the NHANES Dietary Supplement Database. Only ingredients resolved to an existing Organism are represented.
source_contributions.description: The CDC / National Center for Health Statistics publishes the Ingredient Information (DSII) data. Several differently named ingredients in a product can refer to the same organism; their amounts remain separate entries in the aligned lists.
